demos.title: Deterministic scenario explorer
demos.summary: Deterministic control: runs repeated identical deterministic paths of the reviewed public scenario. This is NOT Monte Carlo and carries no statistical uncertainty evidence; it serves as the zero-variance negative control for the stochastic flagship demo.

demos.title: Stochastic growth — Monte Carlo uncertainty

demos.title: Vesting unlocks, concentrated — Monte Carlo uncertainty

demos.boundary: This Monte Carlo demo replays a synthetic, uncalibrated demand series over a synthetic, uncalibrated allocation and samples four illustrative, uncalibrated, explicitly independent priors bracketing library defaults and the declared schedule. Modeled unlock pressure is supply expansion only, not sell-pressure or liquidity modeling. Modeled outcome intervals (P10-P90) are cross-path spreads of simulated outcomes, not confidence intervals and not forecasts. It is not investment, launch, legal, financial, forecast, or decision-grade advice.

demos.title: Vesting unlocks, smoothed — Monte Carlo uncertainty

Executed by the real Monte Carlo runner with seeded reproducibility, outcome intervals, estimator confidence intervals, sensitivity, and convergence evidence.

demos.title: Core solvency archetypes — adapted scenario evidence
demos.summary: Adapted archetype: precomputed canonical bundles of the maintained Z1 core-solvency M1 scenarios executed unchanged at repetitions=1 (baseline and stable published), served read-only with hash-verified tables, neutral publish-time metric names, provenance, and a tested-region disclosure. The collapse preset is visibly blocked: Z1's own L10 hard validation rejects the collapse configuration upstream, and no bundle is fabricated for a scenario Z1 refuses to run. Diagnostic scenario evidence only; no Monte Carlo uncertainty is claimed.
demos.boundary: This adapted demo serves precomputed, hash-verified bundles of deterministic solvency scenarios at repetitions=1. It is directional structural-solvency scenario evidence over the disclosed tested region (2/3 named scenarios published, 1/3 blocked upstream), not Monte Carlo, not a probability estimate, not a forecast, and not investment, launch, legal, financial, or decision-grade advice. The collapse preset is visibly blocked by Z1's own L10 hard validation until Z1 is fixed upstream.
